summary: Scoped review found one blocking architecture issue: the staged redesign adds a header-level layout suppression path that makes the Moja page render without the common header/mobile menu, despite the requested header scope being only the body-class expression. The Moja content, CTA text/URL, generated image references, preserved story paragraphs, and scoped SCSS/CSS are otherwise structurally aligned.

issues.problem: The staged header change does more than add the `moja_body` class: it wraps the common `<header>` in `if (empty($hide_common_layout))`, while `moja-cat.php` sets `$hide_common_layout = true`. That means the Moja page will not render the common header or mobile menu, making the `.moja_body .dr_header...` CSS dead on this page and contradicting the stated mobile menu QA/scope of 'header.php one body-class expression only'.
issues.recommendation: Keep the header rendering path unchanged and limit `header.php` to the body-class expression, or explicitly redesign/review the layout suppression as a separate architecture change with matching footer/header behavior and mobile-menu expectations.

issues.problem: The staged diff rewrites the file line endings across the whole import file even though the only intended semantic change is the `_moja_cat.scss` import at line 105. This makes the review/merge surface much larger than the actual change.
issues.recommendation: Normalize the staged diff so `scss/style.scss` only contains the single `@import "_moja_cat.scss";` addition.

issues.problem: The JSON-LD image URLs for existing characters still point at the legacy `moja-cats_moja.webp` and `moja-cats_kururu.webp` assets while the visible redesigned page uses the new `moja-cat-moja-v1.webp` and `moja-cat-kururu-v1.webp` art.
issues.recommendation: If the new generated art is meant to be canonical for this redesign, update those JSON-LD image URLs to match the visible character assets.

notes_for_next_review: After fixing the header/layout suppression, re-check the rendered Moja page specifically for common header/mobile menu presence plus the already claimed video modal/carousel behavior. Independent `codex exec` review could not run because the local Codex CLI account rejected the configured/default models, so this is a manual read-only review.
